title: Sound from who you play, round 2: the Arisen stays back, a cave or wall to listen by
intro: BEFORE YOU PRESS END: no enemies around, headphones on, and know where a cave mouth, wall or building is (within a short walk). Nothing is timed until you say you are ready. Press End to start.

steps.text: Taking over your main pawn. The Arisen now STAYS where he is (follow off for this test).
GET READY (no timer): walk the pawn about 20 m from the Arisen, next to your cave / wall. Press End when you are there.
A (game as it is): sprint until out of breath, swing, jump. Whose breathing and steps sound close? Does the Arisen sound far away?
B: the pawn you play has the player's sound settings. Same actions. (Last time: sounded good.)
B + C1: loudness by distance from the CAMERA. Turn and walk around: does the Arisen (20 m off) and the world sound right?
B + C2: loudness by distance from the PAWN you play. Better or worse than C1?
B + C2 + D: echo and ambience follow the pawn. Walk into the cave / along the wall, then back out.
Back to the Arisen with all of it on (it should go back to normal by itself). Does he sound like himself? Follow is back on.
All off. Tell Claude: B / C1 / C2 / D, which was best, anything odd.

probes.sound:
local out = {}
local function wc(ch)
  local go = ch and ch:call("get_GameObject")
  return go and go:call("getComponent(System.Type)", sdk.typeof("app.WwiseCharacter")), go and tostring(go:call("get_Name"))
end
local list = {}
pcall(function() list[#list + 1] = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer") end)
pcall(function() local l = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.PawnManager"):call("get_PawnCharacterList"); for i = 0, l:call("get_Count") - 1 do list[#list + 1] = l:call("get_Item", i) end end)
for _, ch in ipairs(list) do
  local w, nm = wc(ch)
  if w then out[#out + 1] = nm .. ":" .. tostring(w:call("get_CharacterCategory")) .. "/" .. string.format("%.2f", w:call("get_CharacterRTPC") or -1) .. "/" .. tostring(w:call("get_IsRTPCTreatedAsPlayer")) end
end
pcall(function() out[#out + 1] = "decayAtPlayer=" .. tostring(sdk.find_type_definition("via.simplewwise.Driver"):get_method("get_CalcDistanceDecayAtPlayerPos"):call(nil)) end)
return table.concat(out, " ")
